data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's derivation contradicts SRC_001 as mathematical artifacts even though both yield 648, because SRC_002's mechanism initially computes the exactly-two-same complement as 9 × 2 × 9 = 162 (ignoring the ordering of the pair), while SRC_001 computes the same category as AAB + ABA + BAA = 81 + 81 + 72 = 234 (respecting ordering and the asymmetry of the hundreds-place constraint). Their agreement at 648 depends on compensating errors in SRC_002's intermediate step — the '162' is only correct if we later treat 'all-same' as 9 rather than also respecting position, which obscures the PIE structure SRC_001 makes explicit. This is refuted if SRC_002's 162 is reinterpreted as a deliberately over-corrected quantity that cleanly simplifies to 252 without double-counting, i.e. if the formula 9 × 2 × 9 already accounts for all 252 tuples including the AAA triple via a different partition.
